replacement.title: Clip Performance Tracking
replacement.definition: Published clips must have their views, performance, and engagement tracked to provide transparent performance data.

patches.decision_note: The client explicitly describes per-clip views, performance, and engagement tracking, which is an independent data-tracking behavior absent from the inventory.

patches.decision_note: The verification is valid, but the observed behavior should exclude the project delivery deadline and retain only the reviewed deliverable and acceptance result.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hey team,

To start, I apologize for [FREELANCER_NAME_002] recent delay. Upwork had placed us on hold, which kept us from moving as quickly as we wanted. That issue is resolved now, and we're back at full speed.

During [FREELANCER_NAME_002] hold, I created a new system designed to simplify [FREELANCER_NAME_005] work and help you reach [FREELANCER_NAME_005] 100 approved clips sooner.

Here are [FREELANCER_NAME_002] updates:

1\. Clip variations - you can use [FREELANCER_NAME_002] same body clip while swapping only [FREELANCER_NAME_002] hook/opening to create another version. Using this method, you can reuse a single clip up to 2-3 times. That means less work and more clips.

2\. Shorter clip styles - these take less time to produce and are simpler to combine, making [FREELANCER_NAME_002] path to 100 approved clips much smoother. If you choose, some of you may even go beyond 200.

3\. Hook training video - I'm creating a video that will teach you how to identify strong hooks. A single long video can provide close to 50 clip ideas, making content discovery quicker and easier.

We recognize and appreciate [FREELANCER_NAME_002] work, loyalty, and commitment all of you have shown, even while delays were happening on our side. [FREELANCER_NAME_002] purpose of this new system is to help you increase [FREELANCER_NAME_005] earnings without adding unnecessary headaches.

As we expand and add more people to [FREELANCER_NAME_002] team, our goal is to develop you into Lead Clippers. Mastering this new method is [FREELANCER_NAME_002] first step toward that.

Additional details and examples will be shared soon. Let's get moving again.

\- [CLIENT_NAME_001]
